import os
import base64
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from uuid import UUID

from pymongo import MongoClient
from bson import ObjectId
from bson.binary import Binary
from bson.decimal128 import Decimal128
from bson.int64 import Int64
from bson.max_key import MaxKey
from bson.min_key import MinKey
from bson.regex import Regex
from bson.timestamp import Timestamp

client = MongoClient(os.environ.get("MONGODB_URI", "mongodb://localhost:27017"))
collection = client["shop"]["orders"]

query = {
    "id": ObjectId("65f1c0de9a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b"),
    "at": datetime(2024, 3, 1, 10, 20, 30, 123000, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
    "long": Int64(9007199254740993),
    "decimal": Decimal128("0.10"),
    "int": 42,
    "double": 2.5,
    "big": 3000000000,
    "regex": Regex("^ma", "i"),
    "uuid": Binary.from_uuid(UUID("3b241101-e2bb-4255-8caf-4136c566a962")),
    "binary": Binary(base64.b64decode("AQID"), 0),
    "timestamp": Timestamp(1700000000, 1),
    "min": MinKey(),
    "max": MaxKey(),
    "none": None,
    "yes": True,
    "nan": float("nan"),
    "list": [1, "a"],
    "empty": {}
}
sort = [("at", -1)]

for doc in collection.find(query, sort=sort):
    print(doc)
